root_idea.summary: The lexical record is explicitly heterogeneous rather than governed by one single regular root principle. Its branches include vivid or unmixed coloration, cracking and bursting, bubbles, and several independent conventional nouns and verbs.
root_idea.development: The attested vocabulary preserves separate branches for color terms, cracking or opening with sound, bubbling, poverty and calamity, and specialized concrete or figurative usages; these branches should not be treated as one uniform direct meaning.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is displayed under the normalized adjective citation form فَاقِعٌ.

senses.definition: Intensely yellow, with a vivid and pure yellow hue.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic phrase صَفْرَاءُ فَاقِعٌ to describe the cow's color; the emphasis is on genuine, unmixed yellowness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be intensely yellow or free from admixture in color; of a skin or hide, to be beautiful and clear in color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a thing's color and specifically of skin, hide, or tanned hide.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Lane records this usage of a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a boy, to become active, grow, or grow into a young man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a boy's maturation or increasing activity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die from, or in consequence of, heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested as a description of a man's death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of calamities or the vicissitudes of time, to crush a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with calamities as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To steal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Form I verbal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To emit wind from the anus with a sound; to do so vehemently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related intensive action is also associated with the verbal noun تَفْقِيعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To twist the sides of the mouth or open the mouth diffusely in speech, uttering meaningless talk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II usage concerning manner and quality of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something crack or burst with a sound, including cracking the joints of the fingers and striking a rolled rose leaf until it splits open.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The finger-joint and rose constructions are expressly attested examples of this sound-producing action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To crack or crackle with a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of such things as flint in a fire or salt thrown into a fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a hide red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II color usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become poor or needy, or to be in an evil condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV intransitive usage describing severe deterioration of condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the eyes, to become white, cleft or fissured, or filled with foul white matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional bodily-condition expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cleft, fissured, or rent open.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VII intransitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intense whiteness; also intense yellowness or yellowness free from admixture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a substantive verbal noun or noun of color.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An emission of wind from the anus with a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun corresponding to the bodily action described under فَقَعَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of truffle, especially the white, soft, inferior, or quickly spoiling kind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural forms include فِقْعَةٌ, أُفْقُعٌ, and فُقُوعٌ; related fungus identifications are also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of extreme vileness or abjection, by comparison with the easily trampled truffle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiom أَذَلُّ مِنْ فَقْعٍ بِقَاعٍ and its variants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pointed toes of a type of boot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or specialized usage marked as figurative in the lexical source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely red; an epithet applied to a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry records variant vocalization and treats the word as an epithet of intense redness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A white pigeon or a kind of white pigeon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is explained through comparison with the white truffle called فَقْعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely white.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet of strong whiteness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who emits wind from the anus frequently or in great measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive personal epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strong or vehement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage recorded separately from the bodily epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bad, corrupt, or wicked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage applied to a person or thing characterized as corrupt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A barley beverage whose foam rises on its surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional noun for a frothy beverage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant which becomes hard and horn-like when it dries.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific plant name distinct from the beverage usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bubble or rounded bubble-like globule rising on water, wine, or a similar liquid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is فَقَاقِيعُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of فُقَّاع.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational noun derived from the beverage name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intensely red or intensely white; more generally, free from admixture when applied to a color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader adjectival color range is distinct from the Quran-attested yellow use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A calamity or misfortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is فَوَاقِعُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The worst condition of poverty or deprivation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression فَقِيرٌ مُفْقِعٌ, describing one reduced to the most desperate condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The anus, regarded as the instrument by which wind is emitted vehemently with a sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrumental anatomical noun; مِفْقَاعٌ is recorded as a related form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a pointed front, especially a boot with a pointed toe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression خَفٌّ مُفَقَّعٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A black bird with a white base to its tail that pecks at camel dung or similar matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bird name.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Sound-producing bursting of a rolled rose leaf represented.
Cracking or crackling in fire represented.
A tentative gloss meaning contracted is attributed to Reiske but is explicitly judged likely to result from an erroneous written form.
White, fissured, or diseased eyes represented.
Becoming cleft or rent open represented.
Noun for audible emission of wind represented.
Truffle meaning and its figurative comparison are both represented.
Additional fungus identifications subsumed under the truffle meaning.
Frequent or abundant audible emission of wind represented.
Strength and corrupt or wicked character are both represented.
Quran-attested yellow usage and broader unmixed-color range are both accounted for.

cautions: The root is explicitly described in the lexical evidence as containing disparate words rather than a single regular semantic pattern.
A tentative Form V interpretation meaning contracted is not assigned because the source itself attributes it to an erroneous written form.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: lane-unit:fqE:34694:g1:sub2: Reiske's interpretation of تَفَقَّعَ as meaning contracted, said of a hand, is retained as ambiguous because the passage explicitly judges it probably based on an erroneous writing.
